title: Brocode plugin manifest (contract 1.13)
description: plugin.toml: a plugin folder's manifest. Generated from crates/opencode-plugin-spec/contract.json.

id.description: The plugin's id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It prefixes commands (<id>.<command>) and contracts.

version.description: The plugin's own version, as semver.

contract.description: The contract version the plugin targets, such as "1.0".

description.description: One sentence about what the plugin adds.

entry.description: The window half's module, relative to the plugin folder.

app.description: The app half's module, such as "app.luau". Omit it for a plugin with no app half.

os.description: The platforms it runs on. Omit it for all.

channels.description: The app channels it loads in. Omit it for all.

name.description: The name passed to Store:Value or Store:SessionValue.

scope.description: One value for the app, or one per session.

stores.description: The stores it uses, by name and scope. Every store of a plugin is in memory before its setup runs, declared or not; the list documents them.

page.description: The page: plugins, a host page, or one of this plugin's settings pages.

settings_search.description: Settings search entries found without loading the plugin.
